elements.label: System prompt text typing
elements.text: You are a sophisticated yet practical weekend planning assistant. You suggest activities, restaurants, and entertainment based on their interests, budget, and schedule. Your suggestions always include...

pattern.description: The System Prompt field takes focus with a gradient glow and its text types on quickly, while the form scrolls up and a slow push-in runs. Focus then hops to First Message, which starts typing. At left, the 'Build, test, and deploy.' caption builds word by word with the voice-over.
pattern.why_premium: Typing is sped up to read as effortless. A gradient focus ring passes from field to field to lead the eye, and the caption words land on the narrated verbs, so the UI demo and the message move together.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.form', {y:-110, scale:1.06, duration:0.6, ease:'power2.inOut'}, 0).to('.sys-prompt', {'--glow':1, duration:0.2}, 0).to('.sys-prompt .text', {text:{value:fullPrompt}, duration:0.45, ease:'none'}, 0).to('.sys-prompt', {'--glow':0, duration:0.2}, 0.45).to('.first-msg', {'--glow':1, duration:0.2}, 0.45).to('.first-msg .text', {text:'He', duration:0.1, ease:'none'}, 0.5); caption words: gsap.fromTo('.cap-word', {opacity:0.4, y:10}, {opacity:1, y:0, duration:0.25, ease:'power2.out'}) at each narrated word start.
build_hint.remotion: Typed text: fullPrompt.slice(0, Math.floor(interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [0, fullPrompt.length], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}))). Form translateY and scale via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad) over 18 frames. Glow opacity: interpolate per field. Caption words: spring({frame: frame - wordFrame, fps, config:{damping:200}}) driving opacity and translateY 10 to 0.

notes: camera.move is push_in (scale 1.065) plus an upward drift, which may be a camera push or the form scrolling; code should separate the two. The caption words Build,/test, (b11/b08) and the cursor appear static in this burst and are not listed. There are no SFX candidates.
